name: ci-monitor
description: Token-efficient exact-head CI monitoring with native same-session continuation.

interface.shortDescription: Wait token-free, then queue the same Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Monitors one exact GitHub or GitLab CI target without model polling, validates the expected commit, and queues one terminal continuation to the originating Codex session.
interface.defaultPrompt: Monitor this exact CI run without model polling, then continue this same Codex session when it reaches a terminal state.
